<function name="IsMouseDown" parent="input" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Gets whether a mouse button is down.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="mouseKey" type="number">The key, see <page>Enums/MOUSE</page>.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Is the key down?</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
